END;

DECLARE
 temp varchar2(5);
 tr_id donations.transaction_id%type;
 dn_id donations.donor_id%type;
 c_date donations.coll_date%type;
 v_status varchar2(2);
 szUnitId VARCHAR2(15);
BEGIN
 nullchk;
 check_package_failure;

 /* This validation was added by Edwin on 03.14.2001 for ISBT check*/
 IF :Global.code_scheme = 'I' then 
 If not CHECK_ISBT_PREFIX(substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,5)) then 
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id:=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.collDate := NULL; --diptiia for SCR 580
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16206');
 End if;

 if not number_check(substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,6,8)) THEN
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id:=null;
 previous_item;
 clear_item;
 show_error('16211');
 end if; 
 szUnitId:=Substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 ELSE
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id;
 END IF;

 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id','D'); --- After the conversion, this line is added to display the unit iD properly
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.RETRIEVE','E');

 :ctrl_block_1.collDate := NULL;

 Begin 

 select transaction_id,donor_id,coll_date into tr_id, dn_id ,c_date from donations
 where unit_id = szUnitId; 

 :ctrl_block_1.collDate := c_date;
 :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id := tr_id;

 next_item; 
 Exception
 when no_data_found then
 synchronize;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id','E');
 :ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id :=null;
 :ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id:=null;
 go_item('ctrl_block_1.s_f_unit_id'); 
 show_error('1230');
 check_package_failure;
 when too_many_rows then
 next_item;
 when others then
 handle_error; 
 End; 
END;

declare

 v_local_time date;

begin
 go_block('rem_intr_blk');
 :rem_intr_blk.inter_code := :exist_inter_blk.inter_code;
 :rem_intr_blk.inter_desc := :exist_inter_blk.inter_desc;
 

 if is_timezone_enabled then -- Jairam added per IM 5204 to make sure term date entered is not defaulted to sysdate but its defaulted to local date. on 14-apr-2011
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,v_local_time);

 else

 end if; 
-- above code by jairam

 begin

 into c_perm
 from valid_interdictions
 where inter_code=:exist_inter_blk.inter_code
 and deferral_flag='Y'
 and period_type='P';

 end;

 else

 go_item('rem_intr_blk.reason_cd');
end;

declare

 chp_sysdate date;
begin 

 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate, chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 
 rel_alt := show_alert('release_alert');

 if rel_alt=ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 
 :exist_inter_blk.release_date := chp_sysdate;
 :exist_inter_blk.release_user := :banner.user_id;
 
 /* -- commented and replace with the above code for IM 7324
 update donation_interdictions set release_date = chp_sysdate,
 release_user = :banner.user_id
 where transaction_id=:exist_inter_blk.transaction_id
 and inter_code = :exist_inter_blk.inter_code
 and inter_type=:exist_inter_blk.inter_type
 and trunc(term_date) =trunc(:exist_inter_blk.term_date)
 and nvl(originated_from,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.originated_from,'LPL')
 and nvl(reason_code,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.reason_code,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_id,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_id,'LPL')
 and nvl(group_mode,'LPL')=nvl(:exist_inter_blk.group_mode,'LPL');
 */
 commit;
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 clear_block;
 execute_query;

 end if; 

 
end;

Trigger.Name: PRE-QUERY
Trigger.TriggerText:
DECLARE
 chk_all number :=0;
 szUnitId VARCHAr2(15);
BEGIN
 /* set the donation id */
 
 IF :GLOBAL.code_scheme='I' then 
 szUnitId:=substr(:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id,1,13);
 Else
 szUnitId:=:ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id;
 End if;
 :exist_inter_blk.unit_id := szUnitId;
 /* set the chapter id */

 --default_value('WAD','global.chapter_id');
 default_value(:global.chapter_id,'global.chapter_id');
 /* Check whether the user has ALL access level */
 
 begin
 select distinct 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 --and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between 
 eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) between 
 eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)); -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all = 1 then
 /* set_block_property('exist_inter_blk',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''INTUD'')
 and inter_code in ( select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type=''INTER''
 and b.access_code_value=''ALL''
 and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1)
 and c.view_level<a.inter_level
 and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1))');
 */ 
 
 -- Replaced "sysdate" with "lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)"
 -- Replaced by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448 
 set_block_property('exist_inter_blk',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''INTUD'')
 and inter_code in ( select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type=''INTER''
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and c.view_level<a.inter_level
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date, sysdate + 10))'); 
 
 else
 /* set the default where . Inter type should not be DR ( property ) and the
 interdiction should be effective */

 -- Replaced "sysdate" with "lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)"
 -- Replaced by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448 
 set_block_property('exist_inter_blk',DEFAULT_WHERE,
 'where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id
 and inter_code in ( select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type=''INTER''
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 10)
 and b.access_code_value=c.inter_code
 and c.view_level<a.inter_level
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date, sysdate + 10))
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type=''INTUD'') '); 
 
 
 end if;

PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
BEGIN

declare
 
 c_proc_cd varchar2(5);
 c_don_typ varchar2(5);
 c_last_name varchar2(50); 
 c_middle_name varchar2(50);
 c_first_name varchar2(50); 
 c_ssn varchar2(12);
 c_date_of_birth date;
 c_abo varchar2(5);
 other_inter1 number :=0;
 other_inter2 number :=0;
 chk_all number :=0;
 exist_inter_count number :=0;
 chk_alert number :=0;
 term_cnt number :=0;
begin
 begin
 select donation_type,
 procedure_code,
 drive_id,
 donor_id,
 donor_cue
 into c_don_typ,
 c_proc_cd,
 :ctrl_block_1.drive_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_id,
 :ctrl_block_1.donor_cue
 from donations
 where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id=:global.chapter_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 --show_error('1230'); /* Invalid Unit Id */
 null;
 end;
 
 begin 
 select first_name,
 middle_name,
 last_name,
 decode(gender,'M','Male','F','Female'),
 nvl(blood_type,'NONE'),
 date_of_birth
 into c_first_name,
 c_middle_name,
 c_last_name,
 :ctrl_block_1.sex,
 c_abo,
 c_date_of_birth
 from donors
 where donor_id = :ctrl_block_1.donor_id;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18031'); /* Invalid Donor Id */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 
 :ctrl_block_1.name := ltrim(rtrim(c_last_name))||', '||ltrim(rtrim(c_first_name))||' '||ltrim(rtrim(c_middle_name));
 

 :ctrl_block_1.date_of_birth := to_char(c_date_of_birth,'mm-dd-yyyy'); 
 
 begin
 select description
 into :ctrl_block_1.donation_type
 from valid_donation_types
 where donation_type = c_don_typ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('18035'); /* Invalid donation type */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
 /* populate blood type */
 begin
 select substr(description,1,20)
 into :ctrl_block_1.blood_type
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='ABO'
 and code=c_abo;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 message('Blood Type is not maintained for '||c_abo);
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end; 

 begin
 select description
 into :ctrl_block_1.procedure
 from valid_proc_codes
 where procedure_code = c_proc_cd;
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 show_error('3122'); /* Invalid Procedure */
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 
/* Calculate no of other interdictions */

 begin
 select distinct 1
 into chk_all
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 --and access_code_value ='ALL'
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class 
 from valid_user_access_classes
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 --and sysdate between insert_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between insert_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)); -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)); -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 chk_all :=0;
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 if chk_all=1 then
 begin
 select count(*)
 into :ctrl_block_1.other_inter
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='INTER'
 --and b.access_code_value='ALL'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and c.view_level>=a.inter_level
 --and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date, sysdate + 10)) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
 -- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1);

 select count(*)
 into exist_inter_count
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='INTER'
 --and b.access_code_value='ALL'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and c.view_level<a.inter_level
 --and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date, sysdate + 10)) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
 -- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1);


 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 

 else
 /* Calculate the no of interdictions which doesn't belong to the
 users access classes */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into other_inter1
 from donation_interdictions 
 where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code not in (select access_code_value 
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER' 
 and access_class in 
 (select access_class
 from valid_user_access_classes 
 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 --and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between eff_date and nvl(term_date, sysdate + 10)) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
 -- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1); 

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;

 /*Calculate the no of interdictions placed on the donor but he user
 doesn't have access to remove */
 begin
 select count(*)
 into other_inter2
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='INTER'
 and b.access_code_value=c.inter_code
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and c.view_level>=a.inter_level
 --and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate) 
 between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date, sysdate + 10)) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
 -- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1);

 select count(*)
 into exist_inter_count
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id = :ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and inter_code in (select c.inter_code
 from valid_interdictions c,valid_acl_codes b,
 valid_user_access_classes a
 where a.user_id=:banner.user_id 
 --and sysdate between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between a.eff_date and nvl(a.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and b.access_class=a.access_class
 and b.access_code_type='INTER'
 --and sysdate between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date,sysdate+1) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between b.eff_date and nvl(b.term_date, sysdate + 10) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and b.access_code_value=c.inter_code
 and c.view_level<a.inter_level
 --and sysdate between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date,sysdate+1)) -- Commented by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id, sysdate)
 between c.eff_date and nvl(c.term_date, sysdate + 10)) -- Added by Kishore on 04/24/2012. IM 8448
 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type='INTUD');
 -- and trunc(sysdate) between trunc(insert_date) and nvl(trunc(term_date),sysdate+1);

 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 :ctrl_block_1.other_inter := other_inter1+other_inter2;
 end if; 
/* 
 begin
 select count(*)
 into term_cnt
 from donation_interdictions
 where transaction_id=:ctrl_block_1.transaction_id
 and inter_code in (select access_code_value
 from valid_acl_codes 
 where access_code_type='INTER'
 and access_class in

 where user_id = :banner.user_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1))

 and inter_type in (select code
 from valid_master_codes

 and trunc(term_date)<trunc(sysdate);
 exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
 end;
 if term_cnt > 0 then
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.show_term','E');
 end if;
*/

 if exist_inter_count=0 then
 chk_alert := show_alert('NO_INTER_ALERT');
 execute_trigger('key-clrfrm');
 else
 go_block('exist_inter_blk');
 execute_query;
 item_change('ctrl_block_1.f_unit_id','D');

end;

DECLARE

 l_print_id VARCHAR2(40);
 l_error VARCHAR2(1000);

 populate_chapter_ID(l_chp_id, l_print_id, l_error);
 IF l_error IS NOT NULL THEN
 IF l_error in ('9776','9777') THEN
 show_error(l_error); -- Message Type
 check_package_failure;
 ELSE
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));
 pause;
 END IF; 
 exit_form(no_validate);
 ELSE
 :global.chapter_id := l_chp_id;
 :global.user_printer_id := l_print_id;
 END IF;
EXCEPTION
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 message('Err: ' || sqlcode || '-' || SUBSTR(sqlerrm, 1, 100));pause;
 exit_form(no_validate); 
END;
